title: capsicum breviflorum
intro: Capsicum breviflorum, commonly known as a type of wild pepper plant, is a species of flowering plant in the nightshade family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Capsicum breviflorum include its use as a topical pain reliever and its potential to lower blood sugar levels. The bioactive constituents of this plant include capsaicin, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
